signInFirst: sign in with a real account first
registrationDisabled: registration is disabled — ask an admin for an account
passwordLoginDisabled: password login is disabled — sign in with SSO
externalPassword: this account signs in through an external service — its password is managed there
lastAdmin: there must always be at least one active admin
demoteSelf: you cannot demote or disable your own account
deleteSelf: you cannot delete your own account
monitorValues: monitor must be all, new or none
kindValues: kind must be creator, character or team
issueNotInVolume: that issue is not in this volume
fileNotInSeries: that file is not in this series
listNoBooks: that list has no books in it
arcNoIssues: that arc has no issues at the metadata source
seriesNotMatched: series not matched to a metadata record
notMatched: not matched to a metadata record
noBooksMatched: none of the books could be matched at the metadata source
matchFirst: match this series to a metadata record first — its files can’t be organized without publisher/title/year
supportUnavailable: Sending to support is not available
pluginNotInCatalog: plugin not found in the catalog
pluginCatalogUnreachableDetail: could not reach the plugin catalog: {detail}
siteCatalogUnreachable: could not reach the download-site catalog: {detail}
